name: signed entries balances and returned rows preserve append semantics
input: one deposit one withdrawal and a caller-mutated result list
test:
account = Account()
account.deposit(4, 90)
account.withdraw(7, 25)
assert account.balance(3) == 0
assert account.balance(7) == 65
entries = account.transactions(0, 10)
assert entries == [(4, 90), (7, -25)]
entries.append((99, 99))
assert account.transactions(0, 10) == [(4, 90), (7, -25)]

name: range endpoints are inclusive and equal timestamps retain insertion order
input: two same-time deposits and one later withdrawal
test:
account = Account()
account.deposit(2, 5)
account.deposit(2, 3)
account.withdraw(3, 4)
assert account.transactions(2, 2) == [(2, 5), (2, 3)]
assert account.transactions(2, 3) == [(2, 5), (2, 3), (3, -4)]
assert account.balance(2) == 8
assert account.balance(3) == 4

name: overdrafts invalid amounts reversed ranges and older timestamps fail safely
input: a rejected withdrawal followed by invalid operations
